attempts.summary: Configured node1 to export `/srv/nfs/shared` to node2 and mounted it persistently at `/mnt/shared`. Both nodes use `dataops` UID/GID 4500; the shared directory is 4500:4500 mode 2770. Two-way writes preserve ownership and permissions. Both nodes were restarted serially and fully recovered with changed boot identities, persistent services/mounts, and intact data.
